description: This file contains functions and scripts for platform-specific operations including firmware identification, upgrade procedures, and handling of multiple image formats such as pkgtb and bcm4908img. It is used in the OpenWrt build system for a Broadcom BCM4908-based device.

methods.name: get_content
methods.description: Reads specific bytes from a given file at a specified offset.

methods.name: get_hex_u32_le
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a given offset and outputs as little-endian hex string.

methods.name: get_hex_u32_be
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a given offset and outputs as big-endian hex string.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Returns expected device model name based on current board.

methods.name: platform_identify
methods.description: Identifies firmware format and extracts device info from the image.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_get_image_name
methods.description: Retrieves the image name from a pkgtb firmware blob using device tree.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_get_image
methods.description: Extracts image data from pkgtb firmware blob.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_get_upgrade_index
methods.description: Determines the current upgrade index for pkgtb firmware.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_commit
methods.description: Commits a new firmware image by updating environment variables.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates that the firmware image matches device expectations and format.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_pkgtb
methods.description: Performs a system upgrade with pkgtb format firmware.

methods.name: platform_calc_new_cferam
methods.description: Calculates the new cferam index for firmware boot process.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_ubi
methods.description: Handles upgrade process for UBI formatted images, including flashing and cferam management.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher that chooses the appropriate upgrade method based on firmware type.
